verdicts.reason: A centres the logo, can, headline and CTA stack vertically, so the weight is balanced. But the oversized teal circle sits fully behind the logo and can, which flattens the depth, and the legal line runs across the bottom-left blue circle. Both circles read as floating discs rather than bleeding off the edges as in the original. B keeps the legal text clean and the circles bleed more faithfully, but the whole content stack is crammed into the top 60%, leaving a roughly 250px dead band between the CTA and the fine print. The teal circle also crowds the can's right green dot, making B look more lopsided.
